cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Find the Real Authority
cards.instruction: Probe until you know who can approve, block, or reverse the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before I book the trip, who can still cancel it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The committee approved it. Please book before we lose the coach.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Whose objection would stop you paying the deposit?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The treasurer's. But she's away, and her deputy has the bank login.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Can the deputy release it alone, or does she still need the treasurer's permission?

mechanism: A professionally distinguishes committee assent, bank access and payment authority to discover who can actually release or block trip funds.
confusable: D52 seeks backing for A decision; D54 investigates real approval or veto power instead of collecting support.
comparison: Repair alternative tests who can reverse finance; trip alternative separates login possession from delegated release authority.
seedUse: Trip coach, committee, deposit, treasurer and deputy login derive from D54-a; S03 adds exact authority distinctions.
